response.sql: WITH signal_telescope AS (SELECT s.pulsepersec, t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry), telescope_pulse_avg AS (SELECT telescregistry, equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signal_telescope WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescregistry, equipstatus), status_pulse_avg AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse) as status_avg_pulse FROM telescope_pulse_avg GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg_pulse) as first_mean_val FROM status_pulse_avg), above_first AS (SELECT s.equipstatus, s.status_avg_pulse, s.status_avg_pulse - f.first_mean_val as excess_1 FROM status_pulse_avg s CROSS JOIN first_mean f WHERE s.status_avg_pulse > f.first_mean_val), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg_pulse) as second_mean_val FROM above_first), final_result AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.status_avg_pulse, a.excess_1, a.status_avg_pulse - s.second_mean_val as excess_2 FROM above_first a CROSS JOIN second_mean s WHERE a.status_avg_pulse > s.second_mean_val) SELECT AVG(status_avg_pulse) as avg_pulse_rate_average, AVG(excess_1) as avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess_2) as avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM final_result
